Use case: stylized-concept. NEW ORIGINAL KFB SLOP CHARACTER FAMILY, not an edit or continuation of any generated sheet. Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 true transparent PNG sheet, EXACTLY SIX complete standalone characters, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Input image1 is ORIGINAL ink-family morphology/material reference; image2 is ORIGINAL occupational accessory craft reference. They are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: invent the new subjects below. Never copy their repetitive angry expressions or all-red eyeballs.

Every character is ONE WHOLE CONTINUOUS FOOTLESS dark charcoal/deep violet INK BLOB/SPLAT, thick softly rounded asymmetrical goo lobes, modeled lips and lids, irregular ivory teeth, a few detached droplets. UPRIGHT to camera, full dominant goo body visible below partial collar/accessories. No human torso, legs, feet, severed bust, lying body, cloth-shaped body or furry spikes. WHITE/IVORY SCLERA surrounding distinct RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL in EVERY visible eye. Soft handmade plasticine volumes, fingerprints, subtle violet sheen, warm upper-left studio light, exquisite rounded clay metal/wood/glass/fabric props. Offbeat grotesque cartoon charm, not cute Pixar mascot faces, angular/gritty clay or flat purple patches.

Six expressive peak moments. Different silhouette, mouth tension, lids, gaze and body attitude BEFORE outfit; never six hat-swaps or repeated V-brow grins. Exactly TWO female-read characters in specified cells, conveyed through styling and acting within the same ink species. All mature adults. Satire of petty certainty, institutional rituals and interrupted dignity, affectionate and absurd. Just ONE or TWO bold beautifully made props per actor, held at own body with immediate physical comedy; no complex conceptual contraptions. No floating emotion symbols. NO circular O-mouths or protruding tongues; vary crooked closed smile, flat sag, clenched grin, uneven open laugh and underbite instead.

Strict separated cells with generous empty transparent gutters and safe margins around entire silhouette, props and droplets, each fits comfortably within its own cell. Comparable visual scale without identical proportions. No overlap/touching, no shared objects, no reaching to neighbors. TRUE transparent alpha in all empty spaces and holes; NO background/gradient, scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow disc, painted checkerboard, text/numbers/labels/logos/captions/borders. Occupational/historical/retro-future context through props only.

FRESH SUBJECT FAMILY: HEALTH_CARE_12_2026-11-04; sheet health-selfcare.
TOP LEFT slot1 male HYPOCHONDRIAC SELF-MONITOR: squat crooked bean ink splat, faded mustard pajama collar and tiny cream sleep cap. Eyes very wide WHITE/red/black anxiously DOWN, asymmetric clenched zigzag mouth biting one lower tooth. One goo arm wears a simple soft teal pressure cuff, other hand nervously squeezes its fat red bulb; cuff linked by ONE short thick hose to oversized round brass pressure gauge held against own body. Only one coherent readable apparatus, no text/numbers.
TOP MIDDLE slot2 FEMALE-READ WELLNESS MERCHANT: tall elegant leaning pear ink blob, huge soft violet upper curl, short plum satin collar and one fat copper earring. Ecstatic crooked open tooth LAUGH, one eye smiling almost shut and the other gazing fondly at her prop. Both hands worshipfully cradle ONE tiny bulbous amber glass corked bottle with a large cream stopper and opaque teal clay liquid. No label, glow or magical effects.
TOP RIGHT slot3 male HOSPITAL BILLING CLERK: broad low sagging ink splat, tiny moss eyeshade, worn indigo collar, round brass spectacles. Furious tight UNDERBITE, one wide eye and one squint focused down. Hugs ONE huge cream blank receipt roll unwinding into a SINGLE broad paper curl across his OWN belly, other hand holds a very small stubby pencil. No letters, coin clutter, background or paper crossing cell seam.
BOTTOM LEFT slot4 FEMALE-READ PHYSIOTHERAPIST: compact round springy asymmetrical ink splat, short coral headband and tiny teal sporty collar, subtle lashes. One eye fully shut in physical effort, other WHITE/red/black wide looking right; huge SIDEWAYS toothy grin, NO tongue. Thick rounded goo arms stretch ONE wide mustard rubber exercise loop at belly level, loop pulled into a simple oval, fingers squeeze rubber visibly. Both full ink lobes stand upright.
BOTTOM MIDDLE slot5 male SELF-OPTIMISATION DEVOTEE: very tall narrow ink bean with three short irregular crown lobes, tiny cream zip collar and faded orange wrist cuff. Both white eyes strained upward for approval, thin CLOSED crooked stressed smile with two sparse fangs. Cradles a single large bulbous copper mechanical wellbeing gauge with blank ivory dial, a big ivory winding key at side; one hand winds the key obsessively. Primitive retro-future material, no screen UI/icons.
BOTTOM RIGHT slot6 male old WAITING-ROOM VETERAN: wide heavy asymmetric puddle that remains UPRIGHT facing camera, soft maroon knit cap and short mustard cardigan collar. Very tired half-closed eyes looking left, huge DROOPING lower lip with three widely spaced teeth, no grin. Hugs a plump faded teal round seat cushion like a life preserver, other hand pinches ONE oversized plain brass queue token. No chair/furniture, no numbers, not lying down.
